intro: PhD and postdoctoral opportunities in reinforcement learning, optimization, and transportation and power systems at HKUST.
researchStatement: We welcome highly motivated PhD applicants and postdoctoral researchers interested in reinforcement learning, optimization, and decision-making in transportation and power systems. Applicants from automation, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, civil engineering, and applied mathematics are encouraged to apply. A strong mathematical background is particularly valuable, and candidates with strong potential may apply without prior experience in these application areas.
historicalPositions: one postdoctoral fellowship and multiple PhD positions
